intro.title: Split Payments & Cash Change Due
intro.subtitle: Multi-tender checkout (Cash + UPI + Card), automated change calculation, and instant reconciliation

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 5: Split-Tender Payments and Cash Change Due. At a modern pharmacy counter, customers frequently pay partially in cash and partially via UPI QR, or hand over a large currency note.
Press F8 or click Split Tender to open the multi-payment panel. MediFlow provides dedicated inputs for Cash, UPI, and Debit Card, along with One-Click Exact Tender shortcuts.

When a patient hands over a five-hundred rupee note for a smaller bill, type five hundred into the Cash box. MediFlow instantly calculates the exact change to return in green, preventing mental math mistakes.
For split payments, enter fifty rupees in Cash and one hundred rupees in UPI. The tendered total automatically balances the bill with zero remaining dues.
Press F10 or click Complete Sale to finalize the invoice with all payment methods printed on the thermal receipt. In Part 6, learn Customer Credit Sales and Khata Limit Control.

outro.takeaway: Split Tender (F8): Mix Cash, UPI, and Card on a single bill with automated change due calculation.
